create_iset_singleton: create an ISet from a single integer element using ISet.singleton
create_iset_interval: create an ISet representing a range of integers using ISet.interval
add_element_iset: add an integer element to an existing ISet using the add method
merge_iset: merge two ISet instances together using the merge method or in-place or operator
take_from_iset: split an ISet into two by taking the first N elements using the take method
